notes.title: Multiplayer Concurrency Test 🎉
notes.notes:
[p][b]🚀 It’s Rally Time — DreamWorld needs YOU (and your crew).
[/b]We’re opening [b]10,000 FREE playtest spots[/b] starting now and running [b]weekly stress-test events[/b] to push our MMO tech to its limits.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why jump in now?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]80+ hours[/b] of survival/crafting adventure (think Valheim/Enshrouded/Minecraft). [/p][/*][*][p][b]The most powerful building in gaming[/b]: scale/rotate anywhere, blueprint copy/paste, interactive pieces, and [b]DreamForge AI[/b] (type a prompt → get a custom build piece live in game). [/p][/*][*][p][b]One seamless infinite world[/b] for everyone. Meet at coordinates. Build/craft/fight together. [/p][/*][*][p]Every player plays together in [b]one shared universe[/b], no picking servers! [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Our goal:[/b] hit [b]high concurrency[/b] before [b]Steam October Next Fest[/b]. If we uncover anything critical in testing, we could regroup and hit [b]February Next Fest[/b] even stronger instead. Either way—[b]your playtime now directly shapes launch quality.[/b][/p][p][b]🎯 What to do (takes 60 seconds):[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Wishlist on Steam (so you’re notified on opening)[/b] →[url="https://tinyurl.com/27fz4tb2"] https://tinyurl.com/27fz4tb2[/url][u] [/u][/p][/*][*][p][b]Invite friends/family[/b] who’d love survival, building, or MMOs. (Thank you so much!)  [/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Creator note:[/b] DreamWorld is the [b]first game[/b] where a streamer can say “meet me at X,Y” and [b]everyone can actually show up[/b]—same world, same moment. Ping us if you want a featured Creator Crash night.[/p][p]Let’s make history together. See you in-game! 💫
 — [b]Zach & the DreamWorld Team[/b][/p][p]    [/p][p][b]What’s new since many of you last played[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]80+ hr survival loop[/b]: gather → build → craft / farm → gear up → explore → fight Fears (bosses). [/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Full world destructibility[/b] & terraforming (level or raise mountains, mine forever, reshape terrain to fit your vision). [/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Insane UGC scale[/b]: players have built cities with [b]tens of millions[/b] of pieces in one area—still smooth on older PCs. [/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]DreamForge AI[/b]: place a forge, type a prompt, get a custom building piece [b]live[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]One world for all[/b] (no “join my server” headaches).

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why this matters right now[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re proving the [b]mass-multiplayer ceiling[/b] before Next Fest. [/p][/*][*][p]Large turnouts = better data = better stability for everyone. [/p][/*][*][p]The more [b]Wishlists[/b], the more Steam shows DreamWorld to others (this literally compounds our reach).

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Help us smash these milestone goals[/b][/p][list][*][p]🎮 [b]Concurrent Players[/b]: 500 → 1,000 → 5,000 → 10,000 [/p][/*][*][p]💚 [b]Wishlists[/b]: 10k → 25k → 50k → 100k
 We’ll share progress live during events and shout out top groups that bring the most players.[/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][p align="center"][b]Since we haven’t updated you all in a while, here's a list of some of our larger projects we’ve been working on! Keep in mind this is only the tip of our Hundreds of features, improvements, fixes, and more that we’ve accomplished![/b][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚙️ Performance & Optimization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]General Performance - Vastly improved general performance with various optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Virtual Texture Streaming - Reduce memory overhead when streaming textures[/p][/*][*][p]Large Selection Positioning - Improved asset outline calculation so more assets can be moved at once[/p][/*][*][p]Particles - Optimizations made to several particle effects [/p][/*][*][p]Game Loading - Due to optimizations with mesh and asset loading, the game will load significantly faster than it used to[/p][/*][*][p]Stability – Game stability has improved significantly. Fixed bugs that caused game crashes [/p][/*][/list][p][b]🆕New & Improved Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Object Destruction - Building pieces now have HP and can be progressively damaged by tools. This HP determines the lifespan of assets on Islands[/p][/*][*][p]Bow Improvements - New bow meshes, combat system and balance adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Dream Spire –Added new visuals and difficulty options[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Intro Sequence – Invoker, visuals, and optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Food Overhaul - Food takes less time to eat but eating causes reduced movement speed and is interrupted by taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]Farming - Performance optimizations, improved snapping and replication, and variable plant sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded language support – More languages now supported in menus and gameplay[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🛠 Gameplay & Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tutorial - New and updated quest stages and objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple Islands - Multiple floating islands connected by Color-coded portals below the city on each island[/p][/*][*][p]Asset Locks - New requisites to unlock assets in the cottage and castle sets have been added to make the sets tied to player progression[/p][/*][*][p]Asset Scaling - Asset scaling has been made more consistent. Items can no longer be shrunk or enlarged past their limits using other anchor assets[/p][/*][*][p]DMs - Players can now DM each other using the chat as long as they are friends. Use /help in game to learn how[/p][/*][*][p]Controller optimizations – Better input navigation and controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Social gameplay – Crafting benches and other interactables are now accessible to all[/p][/*][*][p]Reliquary Permissions – Reliquary protections settings now work for asset destruction and interactions[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎮 UI & UX Polish[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved Map - Map no longer shows floating islands when on the mainland[/p][/*][*][p]Control Icons - Keyboard/Controller icons improved for better readability and consistent spacing[/p][/*][*][p]Object Catalog - Reorganized object catalog and updated object descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Unintentional HUD Openings - Fixed a few issues where typing into text input would cause a HUD to open[/p][/*][*][p]Discord - Added a Discord button to the settings tab[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip Updates - Improved tooltips for better visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Item Icons - Updated many outdated icons and descriptions for items and assets[/p][/*][*][p]Login from Client - New players can now create and play with new accounts without ever leaving DreamWorld![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Battle Replication – Vyne now appears for all players in sync[/p][/*][*][p]Mob Mesh - Fixed a bug where mobs’ meshes would occasionally get messed up when killed[/p][/*][*][p]Death Chests - Fixed a bug where death chests would disappear on relog or be non-interactable[/p][/*][*][p]Durability - Fixed several bugs that would cause tool durability to be changed unexpectedly[/p][/*][*][p]Mounting Brackets - Improved placement on mounting brackets for several broken items. Please let us know if you find more :) [/p][/*][*][p]Improved Lighting: Transitions between dark and light are now smoother, and the intro sequence also has better lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory & Crafting – Item duplication works properly and custom materials on built items display correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard Translations – Keyboards in different languages now work in build mode[/p][/*][*][p]Personalizations – Base name now saves and populates in chat accurately[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎨 Art & Assets[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Building Pieces! Check out the cottage set and the start of our next Castle Building Set[/p][/*][*][p]New Forges - Brand new meshes for the Blast Furnace, Scorchforge, Limestone Lock, Incinarium, Smaugian Igniter, and Morian[/p][list][*][p]The old versions will still be usable as long as they have already been placed in the world prior to this update[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Birch Logs - New birch logs added to islands to replace oak logs[/p][/*][*][p]Treasure Chests - Vibrant and Aesthetic chests have been added for your loot needs[/p][/*][/list]

notes.notes:

notes.title: 🚀 Sneak Peek: What’s Coming in Dream World’s Next Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Dream World adventurers! 🌟[/b]

Our next big update is just around the corner, and while we’re still making final adjustments, we wanted to give you a glimpse of what’s coming. This isn’t the full patch list—expect official patch notes closer to launch—but here are some key highlights to get excited about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/db49e73e9f3c4cf8b0bb15d1dfd53e4e00aa6975.png[/img]

[b]🔥 What’s in Development?[/b]
🏹 Mob Refactor – Smarter Enemies & Better Combat
We’re continuing to refine enemy behavior, making combat more dynamic, responsive, and strategic.

✅ Improved combat logic – Enemies will move and attack more intelligently.
✅ Better world destruction mechanics – Environments react more realistically during battles.
✅ Multiplayer replication improvements – Smoother AI behavior in co-op play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/0cab4b469e3f56368d3858c58abb577e635d8eba.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Confirmed: Full Controller Support![/b]
We’re happy to confirm that full controller support is coming in this update! Gamepad players will enjoy seamless input, improved UI navigation, and better responsiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/26090dcb527808757fc75c947d36ab9b2b528731.gif[/img]

[b]🏙 Performance Optimizations & Area Protection Fixes[/b]
This update also includes major performance improvements, especially for large cities and multiplayer environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/541066b5a192edd3b928eba06b079b7e0b7ebb88.png[/img]

✅ City performance optimizations – Faster load times & improved FPS.
✅ Area Protector System Fixes – Bug fixes and general stability improvements.
✅ Secondary Drop System Tweaks – More balanced and dynamic loot distribution.

📌 Until then, make sure to [b]follow and wishlist DreamWorld [/b]so you don’t miss anything!

notes.title: Important Update on the DreamWorld Playtest 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey Dreamers! 🎮

The DreamWorld Playtest is nearing its next big milestone! [b]Starting Monday, December 2nd, we’ll no longer allow new players to join the playtest.[/b] If you haven’t already, download the game on Steam and log in before then!

notes.title: 📢 DreamWorld Patch Notes - 10/31/2024 📢
notes.notes:
✨ Improvements:
[list]
[*]Enhanced lighting and ambiance to create a more immersive world.
[*]Updated tutorial flow with improved instructions and text for a smoother onboarding experience.
[*]Adjusted smelting options according to furnace tier, optimizing crafting efficiency.
[*]Improved collision generation for certain destructible objects, reducing lag and enhancing [*]performance.
[*]Refined tool meshes and materials for a more polished look.
[*]Improved reliquary location checks to handle irregular shapes more effectively.
[*]Updated UI for reliquaries, stats, and skills panels.
[*]Added a pulse effect to highlight overlapping limited assets for better placement guidance.
[*]Enhanced digging logic, making it easier to level up with better tools.
[*]Improved recipe balance and adjusted several crafting requirements.
[/list]

🐞 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed resource loss issue when crafting and cancelling smelting.
[*]Resolved resource issues related to placing, moving, and upgrading various assets.
[*]Corrected issues with destroying smelters and cooking stations while in use.
[*]Fixed mob aggro range and chase radius; reintroduced mob "home" logic.
[*]Prevented friends from opening chests inside owner's reliquaries.
[*]Generated assets can now be trashed, allowing for additional generations.
[*]Improved chest behavior to prevent item overflow when inventory is full.
[*]Fixed night mob behavior and enhanced its underlying logic.
[*]Improved tutorial text, icons, and descriptions across multiple areas.
[/list]

notes.title: DreamWorld Referral Program – Invite Friends & Earn Rewards! 🎁
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamers!

We’re thrilled to introduce the [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend]DreamWorld Referral Program[/url], where you can earn rewards by inviting friends to play DreamWorld! 

[h3][b]Here’s how it works:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend][b]Sign up on Gleam[/b][/url]
Visit our Gleam page here and sign up using your email. Connect your Steam account to activate the referral tracking system.
[*] [b]Play DreamWorld on Steam:[/b]
If you haven’t already, request access to play DreamWorld on Steam and dive into the infinite world of adventure. This step is required to unlock your referral link.
[*] [b]Generate Your Referral Link:[/b]
Once you’ve connected your Steam account, click on the “Refer Friends” button on the Gleam page. You’ll receive a unique referral link that you can start sharing immediately.
[*] [b]Share Your Link Everywhere:[/b]
Post your link on social media, share it in gaming groups, or send it directly to friends. The more you share, the more chances you have to earn points!
[*] [b]Earn Points for Successful Referrals:[/b]
For every friend who signs up using your link and plays at least once, you’ll earn +10 points. Remember, your friend must play at least once for the referral to count.
[*] [b]Redeem Your Rewards:[/b]
For every 100 points (equivalent to 10 successful referrals), you’ll receive a $10 Amazon gift card! Points are automatically tracked, and rewards are sent to the email you registered with Gleam every Friday.
[/olist]

[b]This Event runs until November 15th.[/b]

Want to learn more about how to maximize your rewards? [url=https://www.playdreamworld.com/blogpost/bbbeb6e1-d832-420f-af82-5073df9bba6d]Read the full blog post here![/url]

Every referral counts! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out on Discord or email support@playdreamworld.com

Stay awesome, keep dreaming, and see you online! 🪐✨

notes.title: DreamWorld's Steam Playtest Coming October 10th
notes.notes:
DreamWorld is officially launching our first Steam Playtest, Thursday October 10th!!!

To sign up, just scroll down on our Steam Page and click “Request Access”. We will be letting a limited number of players in starting October 10th. This free playtest will be live for a month, and possibly extended further.

You will receive an email from Steam when you have been admitted. Be sure to reserve your spot now!!! To be notified of updates on Steam, please also “Add to Wishlist” and “Follow”.

As part of this launch, we will no longer support DreamWorld from our native launcher. All releases for the foreseeable future will be on Steam.

As always, free to ask us any questions here in Discussions, or in our Discord Channel:
https://discord.gg/btxHUQe8ZH


Please tell all your friends to sign up as well, we want to make this DreamWorld launch as big as possible!
